name: Oukaya Shigure
source:
The owner of Oukaya. He's strict when it comes to work and performance, but looks after the harlots' health behind the screen. An intellectual person with a broad knowledge.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/11/19/yoshiwara-higanbana/]Otome Jikan's character profile translations[/URL].]
